copy.heroHeadline: Wills, estates and business law in plain English
copy.heroSubheadline: We help Denver families and small businesses plan ahead, settle estates and set up companies, with fees agreed before we start.
copy.about: Harper & Lin is a small Denver law firm. We focus on estate planning, probate and business formation. You work directly with an attorney, we explain your options and the costs in writing, and we return calls and emails promptly.

sectionIntros.services: Fixed fees where we can quote them, and a written estimate where we cannot.
sectionIntros.faq: Common questions before a first meeting.
sectionIntros.contact: Tell us briefly what you need and we will call you to arrange a meeting.

serviceDescriptions.description: A will, and a trust where it suits your family, drafted and explained clause by clause.
Powers of attorney, health care directives and beneficiary forms, so your wishes are written down.
We guide personal representatives through each court step and the paperwork that comes with it.
Choosing an entity, filing with the state and drafting an operating agreement for your company.
Purchase contracts checked and closing documents prepared for home sales and purchases.

faq.question: Can we meet by video?
faq.answer: Yes. Many clients meet us by video, and documents can be signed at our office.

faq.question: How do your fees work?
faq.answer: Many services have a fixed fee. For others we give you a written estimate before any work begins.

faq.question: Do I need a lawyer for probate?
faq.answer: Not always. In a first meeting we look at the estate and tell you plainly whether you need us.
